The petitioner has focused the instant Writ Petition praying for passing of an order by this Court in directing the respondents 1 and 2 from closing the fair price shop run by it and hand over the same to the fourth respondent.
2. Heard both sides.
3. By consent, the main Writ Petition itself is taken up for final disposal.
4. According to the petitioner, its fair price shop is registered in R.C.No.22412232000187 under Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and the same is renewed periodically.

Further, it is learnt that the fourth respondent/Association had passed a resolution dated 25.06.2013, with the bald allegation that public are facing many troubles by the misconduct of fair price shop run by the Women Association at Rayappanpatti (run by the petitioner) Anaimalayanpatti and Anaipatti.

Apart from that, they had decided to obtain permission from the respondent Nos.1 and 2 to retake the said fair price shop for the reasons that now the Sangam is growing and that the said shop would increase their income etc.
5. The grievance of the petitioner is that a detailed representation to the respondents 1 to 3 was submitted, but the respondents had remain silent and not acted till date.

Hence, the petitioner is constrained to file the present Writ Petition praying for passing of an order by this Court in restraining the respondents 1 and 2 from closing the fair price shop run by the petitioner forum (Iyakkam).
6.

The learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents 1 to 3 fairly submits that the first respondent would consider the representation of the petitioner, dated 26.08.2013, if reasonable time is granted by this Court.

7. In view of the fact that the petitioner's representation dated 26.08.2013 is pending as on date and this Court, at this stage, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, simplicitor,
directs the first respondent/District Collector, Theni District to look into the representation of the petitioner dated 26.08.2013 and to dispose of the same by passing a reasoned speaking order in a dispassionate manner, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
The first respondent is directed to provide necessary opportunities to the petitioner/forum, at the time of passing the orders, on the representation of the petitioner.

It is open to the petitioner to produce all necessary records/documents before the first respondent and on such production of the said documents/records, the first respondent shall consider the same and pass orders in the subject matter in issue.
In this regard, the petitioner/forum is directed to lend its instinct co-operation and assistance to the first respondent.
